note: Seeded mechanically from existing character bibles and the locked Ep1 script; fields left null are authoring gaps for the user — never invented.

wantsFromOther.Fuzzby: her admiration — an audience for his heroics
wantsFromOther.Zenny: his safety — and for the work to actually get done

misunderstands.Fuzzby: reads her restraint as an invitation to try harder
misunderstands.Zenny: underestimates how much of his showing-off is FOR her

pairs.affection: deep and unspoken; her almost-smile is the episode's quietest reward
pairs.irritation: his chaos costs her time; her calm steals his thunder
pairs.dependence: he needs her as witness; she needs his energy to make work an adventure
pairs.status: he claims it loudly; she holds it silently — the gap IS the comedy
pairs.emotionalLeverage: one slow blink from Zenny outweighs any crash
pairs.comicContrast: maximum motion against near-stillness in the same frame
pairs.typicalRhythm: his three-beat overcommitment answered by her one-beat deadpan
pairs.privateVulnerability: he fears she finds him ridiculous; she fears he'll get hurt
pairs.underPressure: he escalates and performs; she narrows, stills and names the danger

wantsFromOther.Keen: to be seen as brave enough — worthy of his father's wristbands
wantsFromOther.Keen's Mum: to keep him safe without shrinking him

pairs.affection: carried in objects and hands (the wristbands), almost never in speeches
pairs.status: she holds quiet authority; the wristbands transfer trust, not power
pairs.emotionalLeverage: the father's memory, present but never named aloud
pairs.typicalRhythm: her stillness makes his smallest step forward feel enormous
pairs.privateVulnerability: her grief lives in the hand that lingers on the wristbands
pairs.underPressure: she goes quieter, not louder; he acts before he's ready
